headlines.title: Rockwell Automation acquiring mobile robot maker AGILOX
headlines.summary: Rockwell Automation has agreed to acquire autonomous mobile robot developer AGILOX, expanding its mobile robotics portfolio following its 2023 acquisition of OTTO Motors.
